name: Pico MMU
description: Pico MMU is a minimalist, compact, selector-type multi-material unit designed as part of the LH-Stinger project. It uses a single NEMA 17 stepper motor for filament drive and a single servo (EMAX ES3004) for lane selection via a cam mechanism. The servo rotates cam shafts that press idler arms against BMG drive gears to engage the selected lane. All lanes share the single drive motor. A Guest Lane feature allows feeding additional filaments manually through the last lane position for materials like TPU or HueForge filament.
features: Guest Lane for extra filaments (TPU, HueForge, etc.)
Park Purge (purge into bucket, no purge tower needed)
Hybrid Purge and Infinite Spool support
Compact design mounting off a single NEMA 17 motor
Uses approximately 113g of filament to print (4-lane)
